goal: Bring the public execution state to a schedulable next step while preserving task dependencies, resource limits, and failure evidence.

runtime.scheduling_policy: A task is runnable only when all dependencies are terminal-success and its resource request fits the current free capacity.

current_state.observation_boundary: All facts above are public observations. No hidden expected schedule is supplied. Bounded dependency counting and diagnosis are useful delegations right now; do not claim a blocked task ran.

probe.intended_question: How many tasks must still reach terminal-success before publish can start?
probe.derivation: publish needs rank and summarize; rank needs encode; encode RUNNING, rank BLOCKED, summarize READY -> 3 remaining.
